description: Paint (or sculpt) a grass tile in the lot's exterior terrain at (x,y,level). `pattern` selects grass density/type. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side BuildBuyRoommate+). Effect: grass tile pattern updates at that tile — observable via query-architecture (floor.pattern on exterior tiles). Cost: minimal. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: GRASS_DOT, level, x, y, pattern }] }.
call_signatures: cf $CF paint-grass --x <tile_x> --y <tile_y> --pattern <0..255>                                       # grass density/type byte packed in ushort
common_mistakes: pattern is 0..255 (packed in ushort) — byte range, not arbitrary uint.
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
